issue_context.title: Unable to set Instant Stay Arming with TotalConnect Integration
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I use the TotalConnect Integration with HA and it works very well. However, I am not able to perform instant arming (stay arming with no delay). Normally via the panel, this is accomplished using #7 as the code. It is a variation of "Stay Arming" with Instant alarm sound when doors, etc.. are opened with no entry delay. 

I have tried the following configs with and without the optional #7 code (with and without the #) and it always results in regular "Stay" arming. For the night arming I see the panel says "Night" in addition to "stay" but still does not display "Instant" mode. This has never worked as long as I have been using the integration, so it is not necessarily related to 2021.11.x. Everything else works great. 

Please let me know if I am doing something wrong. What is a configuration that would make "Instant" stay arming work? Or is the code perhaps not sending the optional code on the total connect call?

Thanks for very much.

service: alarm_control_panel.alarm_arm_night
target:
  entity_id: alarm_control_panel.home
data:
  code: '#7'

service: alarm_control_panel.alarm_arm_home
target:
  entity_id: alarm_control_panel.home
data:
  code: '#7'

service: alarm_control_panel.alarm_arm_custom_bypass
target:
  entity_id: alarm_control_panel.home
data:
  code: '#7'

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

	core-2021.11.2

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

TotalConnect

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/totalconnect/

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
The following never worked, I also tried without the optional code. 

service: alarm_control_panel.alarm_arm_night
target:
  entity_id: alarm_control_panel.home
data:
  code: '#7'

service: alarm_control_panel.alarm_arm_home
target:
  entity_id: alarm_control_panel.home
data:
  code: '#7'

service: alarm_control_panel.alarm_arm_custom_bypass
target:
  entity_id: alarm_control_panel.home
data:
  code: '#7'
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

_No response_

Hey there @austinmroczek, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`totalconnect`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L543) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

---

[totalconnect documentation](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/totalconnect)
[totalconnect source](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/tree/dev/homeassistant/components/totalconnect)
<sub><sup>(message by IssueLinks)</sup></sub>

Sorry what you described above has never worked.  Since we gather the usercode in the configuration flow (user setup in the UI) we don't actually use the `code` as you show above.  It's being silently ignored.

Adding support for Arm Instant is something I can do, but it will take some time.  And I might ask you to help me test it.
That would be great. Absolutely, I would be glad to test it. Thanks very much.
I'm going to start on this soon from https://github.com/austinmroczek/home-assistant/tree/instant_arm

@austinmroczek yes, I am able to use that as you mentioned, but that simply arms the system in stay mode with delay,  Arm instant however is stay arming without delay, meaning that if any of the doors, etc.. are opened, the siren goes off instantly - this is described at https://www.alarmgrid.com/faq/what-is-the-difference-between-arm-stay-and-arm-instant

Let's make sure the underlying `total_connect_client` package works properly for you first.  The below assumes you know how to use the command line.  While it is probably easiest to test this from the machine hosting your HA, it could be from any computer with python installed.

Download version [2021.11.5](https://pypi.org/project/total-connect-client/) using pip:
`pip install --upgrade total_connect_client`

Then run the "live" arm instant function using
`python -m total_connect_client.arm username 123456=7890 2`

where:
- 123456 is your location ID
- 7890 is your usercode/PIN
- 2 means arm instant (to see other options, remove the 2 and execute command)

This should put you in "arm stay instant" mode.  Let me know either way.

I have it working for me in total_connect_client and HA.

Once we know the underlying code works for you/your panel, then try my draft code as a custom component.

Using my [instant_arm branch](https://github.com/austinmroczek/home-assistant/tree/instant_arm) 

Copy the entire contents of `components/totalconnect` into `<config_dir>/custom_components/totalconnect`
where config_dir depends on your installation
I have Arm Away Instant and Arm Stay Instant working.  We don't know the "ArmingCode" for Arm Night Instant.  If you want, play around with the command line function above and try numbers above 4.

@austinmroczek After I copied the totalconnect folder as you mentioned, when I re-start HA - I see the following in the log 2021-11-22 18:24:11 ERROR (SyncWorker_1) [homeassistant.loader] The custom integration 'totalconnect' does not have a version key in the manifest file and was blocked from loading. See https://developers.home-assistant.io/blog/2021/01/29/custom-integration-changes#versions for more details. So, I added a "version": "1.0.0" to the manifest file and restarted HA and that log msg went away. But when I go to see the available functions, I don't see any new instant related functions on the alarm_control_panel service I can use. I am sure I am missing something. Perhaps I am missing the updated total_connect_client but don't know where to download it from and put it where??

Please help. Thanks

Sorry I left incomplete directions. 

Go to Developer Tools then Services.  Scroll down and there should be TotalConnect arm stay instant.  Pick it and then your alarm panel should be the only option

@austinmroczek  I tested the arm stay instant. Works perfectly. I had created a script in which the following executes below. Thanks very much. 

service: totalconnect.arm_stay_instant
target:
  entity_id: alarm_control_panel.home

Ok great.  I need to look over things a bit more and add tests for it, then submit as final.

Anything else it should do?  I don't know if adding buttons for arm instant on the alarm panel UI would be good, or if that would make it too cluttered.  Also I'd have to figure out buttons...

As far as I am concerned, I cannot think of anything else. Would the final continue to have the two instant arming functions on the TotalConnect service or would they be part of the alarm_control_panel service? It does not matter to me either way, I was just curious. As far as buttons, whatever you think is best. For me, in HA, I have a good night script which activates a scene in addition to a few other things it does and finally invokes total connect arm stay instant. This HA good night script is exposed to an Alexa routine via Nabu Casa. Thanks again for this great improvement.

Changes to the core alarm_control_panel impact about 35 other integrations, and to my surprise very few of them support a concept like arm instant.  It was decided to keep this separate for now, so it will continue to be a TotalConnect service.

I probably won't get this submitted until next weekend due to family activities.
@austinmroczek  Sounds great. Thanks much.
